review.why: A full job-search pipeline with offer scoring, CV generation and tracking, if you accept installing its separate repository.
review.summary: Router for an open-source job search agent: evaluates job offers, scans portals, generates CVs and cover letters, tracks applications, prepares interviews. It only dispatches to mode files in a separate repository, so it does nothing alone.
strengths: Very broad coverage of the job search workflow
Clear mode routing and data-root rules
Keeps user data separate from shipped files
cautions: Needs the external repository, Node.js and its modes to work
Large and complex, with about 40 modes
Portal scanning and application automation may need Playwright
